title: Spend $1000 or More in One or More Transactions at Microsoft, Get $400 Cashback @ NAB Goodies
body:
Deal: Spend $1000 or More in One or More Transactions at Microsoft, Get $400 Cashback @ NAB Goodies

[enigma48] Microsoft still have a great trade in offer going on.
I just priced a surface pro 7+ trade in via the Microsoft site:
Your trade-in value is: $138.00
Value with promotional offer: $938.00
(These are worth like $250 on ebay)
+800 on a trade in and +400 from NAB (assuming they stack) is a nearly free entry-level surface pro.
[JuryWheel] What sort of items are good value to trade in…?
[pizzaofpeace] I got you baby, here're the steps:
You have to buy a device first from Microsoft, which is unfortunately a requirement under this deal
Then, you go to https://msaustralia.teladvance.com/online/home/index.rails
Fill in the details of the old product you're trading in
When you get close to the end, select the item that you bought from Microsoft
It should then show the words special promo that gives a big boost to the product you just bought.
[unison] So you have to buy the full-priced item first and then they do a partial refund on payment card?
[Sertacv2] I did the exact same!
$915 trade in for my surface pro 7+
$400 cashback via amex (spend $1000)
Bought a surface pro 13 inch (12th gen) from $2699 down to around $1400
[godspeed4476] I am thinking of doing something similar. Exchnage my 4 year old Surface 4 notebook for new Base 13 inch Surface, it would set me back by 700 only
[pw2002au] I would imagine they stack as you actually have to purchase a specified device at full price then go upload the receipt and start the claim process.
Create a PDF of your purchase confirmation or confirmation email (show me how)
Restart your trade-in for this device.
By uploading your proof of purchase during the trade-in process, you will be authorized to receive the additional promo value.
Prices are still way too ridiculous…
[Merlict] Good deal.
Man Surface prices have gotten insane with the Ram price hikes though
[BigMoomentum] I was going to trade in my surface pro 7.
But didn't since Elgato Camera hub isn't compatible for Windows on ARM. Need it for my teleprompter.
SAD, cuz thought this would be a good free-ish upgrade.
[pw2002au] 2 months ago you could get the Xbox series X 2tb for $1049 before the $400 cashback ..
Prices have increased ☹️
[MaxiWings] Can you buy M365 yearly subscriptions? Is this allowed for $400 cashback?
[pw2002au] You can only stack 3 years… It does say over multiple transactions though.
[VladImpaler] The $5 back off $20 at Baker's Delight is more useful.
[bheart] I saw 49 total offers, but nothing for Microsoft. Does everyone receive different offers?
[theredrabitt] Ouch ! That recent $250 increase on the series X is brutal. I bought before the price increase and went in with a mate, $650 pp for a Series X was reasonable IMO.
[halil23] Or do the intelligent way and save your money!! 🤷🏻‍♂️
[iflyin] I had issues with microsoft office updates today on my macbook pro. All documents could only be viewed and no editing permitted. MS Troubleshoot chat didnt help, ChatGPT couldnt resolve, i gave up and went shopping for a surface pro + new MS office. Cost at JB: 2.5K! There was no way id spend that much, so i went home and tried MS troubleshoot chat again and, finally, someone from MS knew what he was doing resolved the issue within 10min and saved me from spending over $2.5k.
